summary: This code creates a basic web server using FastAPI, a modern Python web framework. It sets up a single endpoint that responds to GET requests at the root URL ("/") by returning a JSON message. When someone visits this endpoint, they'll get back a simple greeting.

explanations.3: FastAPI() creates a new web application instance that will handle all incoming HTTP requests.
explanations.5: @app.get("/") is a decorator that tells FastAPI to listen for GET requests on the root path ("/"), similar to how you'd set up a route in other web frameworks.
